description: Use Claude subagents in Codex via an MCP server with parallel delegation across up to four concurrent agents.
release_title: Claude Subagents MCP Server 0.1.0 -- Initial Public Release
release_notes:
Initial release of the Claude Subagents MCP server.

### Highlights

- Spawn up to four parallel Claude subagents from Codex or any stdio MCP client
- Scoped workspace file access with read, batch read (16 files), and optional write tools
- Cursor-based result delivery through `wait_claude_agents` for reliable once-only collection
- Configurable model and reasoning effort per agent, with automatic adaptation for unsupported models
- Follow-up messages to running or idle agents
- Durable task state that persists across client restarts
- Request ID deduplication for safe retries after transport failures
- Zero external dependencies -- runs on Python 3.11+ standard library

See [CHANGELOG.md](CHANGELOG.md) for the full list of features.

This is an initial release, not a production guarantee. CI covers Windows, Linux, and macOS with Python 3.11 through 3.13.
